requirements.text: Personalised Timetable Management: Allow students to customize their timetable with features like color-coding modules, hiding canceled classes, and manually adding personal study blocks.
Automated Grade Notifications: Implement a system for students to receive alerts when new grades are posted, along with reminders for assignment deadlines and exam dates.
Structured Module Feedback System: Create a simple feedback mechanism for students to provide anonymous feedback on content quality, delivery, and resources after the teaching period ends.
Ensure that all new features do not disrupt the existing portal infrastructure and maintain its performance.
Focus on integrating enhancements smoothly with the current functionalities to avoid any additional burdens for students or staff.
